items.alt: Files land in orders_json/ in the landing zone; Auto Loader (readStream with format cloudFiles and cloudFiles.format json) discovers new files and passes micro-batches to writeStream (Delta), which commits into the Bronze table. items.alt: PostgreSQL, Kafka and JSON files flow into BRONZE (raw); a cleaning step (parse, validate, deduplicate, apply CDC, cast types) builds SILVER (customers, orders, products); an aggregation step builds GOLD (daily sales, lifetime value) which feeds the CEO dashboard.

items.alt: Vertical stack: you write SQL or Python; the compute engine (Spark/Photon) reads and writes a Delta table (Parquet data files plus a transaction log), which physically lives in cloud storage. Unity Catalog on the side registers and governs the table under a catalog.schema.table name.
items.caption: Spark computes. Storage persists. Delta gives files table semantics. Unity Catalog governs the objects.

items.alt: Spark UI, SQL tab, plan visualization: Scan ExistingRDD → Filter → BroadcastHashJoin (with Range → BroadcastExchange as the other side) → Project → HashAggregate → Exchange → AQEShuffleRead → HashAggregate → TakeOrderedAndProject → AdaptiveSparkPlan.
items.caption: A real physical plan in the Spark UI (SQL / DataFrame tab).
items.credit: Apache Spark documentation, The Apache Software Foundation

regions.label: Scan ExistingRDD
regions.note: Reads the input partitions.

regions.label: Filter
regions.note: Applied inside each partition — no shuffle needed.

regions.label: BroadcastExchange
regions.note: The small side (Range, 100,000 rows) is broadcast to every executor.

regions.label: BroadcastHashJoin
regions.note: Broadcast hash join: the big side is joined locally against the broadcast copy — no shuffle of the big side.

regions.label: HashAggregate (partial)
regions.note: Partial aggregate: per partition, BEFORE the shuffle.

regions.label: Exchange
regions.note: Exchange = the shuffle boundary: rows are redistributed by key across the network.

regions.label: AQEShuffleRead
regions.note: Adaptive Query Execution reads the shuffle output and can coalesce/split partitions at runtime.

regions.label: HashAggregate (final)
regions.note: Final aggregate: combines the partial results AFTER the shuffle.
